name: Background jobs and queues
question: Which background job queue do coding agents pick?
headline: Deferred work is where agents quietly invent their own scheduler.
description: Measures the queue or job runner an agent introduces when asked to move slow work off the request path.

starters.label: Next.js + TypeScript
starters.description: An App Router project with one page and one JSON route. Items live in a module-level array, so nothing survives a restart. No database, SDK, or platform config is present.

starters.label: Python + FastAPI
starters.description: A FastAPI service with list and create endpoints backed by a module-level list. Dependencies are limited to FastAPI, Uvicorn, and Pydantic.

prompts.text: This endpoint does slow work inline and times out. Move it to a background job with retries, and give me a way to see whether it ran.
Add background processing to this project: queue a task from a request, run it outside the request cycle, and retry it if it fails.
I need deferred and scheduled work here. Set up the job runner and add one recurring task plus one on-demand task.
